# Generated by the tier menu generator in the dev tools: do not edit by hand.
# The shared tier menu (common/scripted_effects/DST_tier_menu_effects.txt explains the state and the shop contract)

# Country scope: the open shop defines line $line$ of group $group$ (other slots stay hidden)
dst_tier_menu_line_exists_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
			maz_coronation_line_exists_trigger = { group = $group$ line = $line$ }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the open shop defines at least one line in group $group$
dst_tier_menu_group_exists_trigger = {
	OR = {
		dst_tier_menu_line_exists_trigger = { group = $group$ line = 1 }
		dst_tier_menu_line_exists_trigger = { group = $group$ line = 2 }
		dst_tier_menu_line_exists_trigger = { group = $group$ line = 3 }
	}
}

# Country scope: a line is chosen in group $group$, so its tier can be set
dst_tier_menu_line_chosen_trigger = {
	hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_pending }
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = dst_tier_menu_line_chosen_tt
		check_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_line
			value = 1
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the open shop can pay dst_tier_menu_cost
dst_tier_menu_can_afford_trigger = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
		}
		maz_coronation_can_afford_trigger = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the Confirm button can be pressed. Something must be chosen, so a stray click on an empty
# window does not end the choosing, unless the open shop cannot afford any line at all (no dead end)
dst_tier_menu_can_confirm_trigger = {
	hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_pending }
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = dst_tier_menu_pick_needed_tt
		OR = {
			check_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group1_line
				value = 1
			}
			check_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group2_line
				value = 1
			}
			check_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group3_line
				value = 1
			}
			check_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group4_line
				value = 1
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
				maz_coronation_nothing_affordable_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	dst_tier_menu_can_afford_trigger = yes
}
